maya: quick sync  change window tonight 01:00-02:00 UTC. Plan: runtime v2.3.1 canary then router v1.9.2 pin. Need ordering confirmed.
quentin: I think runtime first, router after 15-30m if steady. Console must keep ENABLE_HEADER_SPLIT off during canary.
rachel: Confirmed. Console will hold flag. We'll add telemetry to mark which header parser was used.
zane: I'll stage KV ttl tweak for fast revert: set to 30s during window, revert to 5m after. Routing rebalance may bump p50 ~2-4m.
deploybot: [deploybot] preflight checks running: infra cap OK, model quant flagged for mistral-7b-quant -> recommend exclude from canary.
maya: exclude model noted. Rollback triggers: sustained error-rate >=1% for 5m OR p95 +50% for 10m OR router 5xx spike. Rollback plan: runtime-only rollback first.
quentin: I'll watch metrics and enable alerting to #oncall.
maya: rollback commands ready in thread if needed.
deploybot: [deploybot] dry-run commands:
```
/deploy runtime v2.3.1 --canary=5 --exclude-model=mistral-7b-quant --dry-run
/deploy router v1.9.2 --pin=staged --dry-run
```
zane: KV ops ready: `kvctl set-ttl --shard all --ttl 30s` and revert `kvctl set-ttl --shard all --ttl 5m`.
rachel: console telemetry pushed. We'll validate header parsing before T0.
maya: timeline T0=01:00 runtime canary. T0+15m check. If green -> pin router and flip flag. If not -> rollback runtime only. I'll post final variant ids at T-10. :thumbsup:
